sentences.text: A strain named 'Angelakisella massiliensis' was reported as isolated from the ileum liquid sample of a 76-year-old woman.
In a randomized single-blind trial of a low-FODMAP diet, Angelakisella was less abundant among ulcerative colitis patients following that diet.
In a pregnancy cohort in Guangzhou, China, Angelakisella was among gut microbiota described as associated with gestational diabetes mellitus and with GDM-associated metabolites.
